name: list_reminders
description: List reminders by status. ALWAYS use this tool for ANY reminder-related query, including: 'when is my next reminder?', 'what reminders do I have?', 'cancel my X reminder' (need ID first!), 'delete reminder', 'show my reminders', 'check reminders', 'any upcoming reminders?', 'did I miss any reminders?', etc. NEVER answer reminder questions from memory or context - always call this tool to get current state. **CRITICAL**: If user wants to cancel/delete a specific reminder by title, you MUST call this first to get the reminder ID, then call 'acknowledge_reminders' with that ID. Returns reminders with IDs, relative time, and status.

limit.description: Maximum number of reminders to return (default 10)
